description_en: This topic describes the syntax and provides examples of the food segmentation feature (SegmentFood)
description_zh: 本文介绍食品分割SegmentFood的语法及示例
name: SegmentFood

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en:
The format of the returned image.

If this parameter is not set, a four-channel PNG image is returned.
If this parameter is set to `mask`, a single-channel mask is returned.
If this parameter is set to `whiteBK`, an image with a white background is returned
parameters.help_zh:
指定返回的图像形式。

如果不设置，则返回四通道PNG图。
如果设置为`mask`，则返回单通道mask。
如果设置为`whiteBK`，则返回白底图
parameters.name: return_form
